title: Immersive Portals (Forge) with GravityChanger support
description: See through portals and go through them seamlessly without a loading screen.
body:
Immersive Portals (Forge Port) with gravity support reintigrated finally, works with the forge portal gun addition too if you wanna get that one :3

Based from: https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-portals-neoforge but with gravity again like it's Fabric port has had for a long time.  I BADLY wanted gravity to work so I took the past week (01/06/2026 to 06/06/2026) learning Intellj and spotting out the differences so I could reconnect it myself. Those who want trippy gravity effects again but forge, Enjoy ^w^
Thank you to Tfarcenim for building GravityChanger onto Forge !
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gravity-control
